about_text: State Conquest %s · no ads, no account, no tracking, playable offline. All graphics and sounds are original. Font: Nunito (SIL Open Font License).
defeat_hint: No worries – upgrades make you stronger. Try again right away!
endless_desc: Random maps that grow bigger and harder every round. Best round: %d
free_play_desc: Choose map, size, opponents, difficulty and rules freely.
not_enough_coins: Not enough coins – play levels to earn more.
reset_confirm: Really reset your progress? Levels, coins, upgrades and statistics will be lost.
sandbox_desc: All maps, custom rules and any upgrade levels – without affecting the campaign.
sandbox_no_progress: Sandbox: no effect on progress or coins
sandbox_note: Unlimited currency: set any upgrade level directly. Your campaign stays untouched.
tagline: Conquer the map – region by region.
tut_drag: Drag from your blue region to a grey region to conquer it with your troops.
tut_multi: Swipe across several of your regions and release on the target – they all attack together.
tut_ratio: Choose at the bottom how many troops are sent: 25, 50, 75 or 100 %.
tut_tap: Alternative: tap your region first, then the target.
tut_zoom: Big map? Pinch with two fingers (or use the mouse wheel) to zoom and pan.
upg_coin_bonus_desc: More coins for every completed level.
upg_production_desc: Your regions produce new troops faster.
upg_speed_desc: Your troops reach their targets faster.
upg_start_territories_desc: Extra starting regions in designated levels (one more every 5 levels), each with its own garrison.
upg_start_troops_desc: More troops in your starting regions at the start of every level.
upgrades_hint: You earn coins by playing. No purchases, no ads.
